//: Standalone typecheck for @insimul/core (npm run typecheck). Mirrors the root tsconfig.check.json compiler options so core type-checks identically in isolation and as part of the whole-repo check. The `@shared/*` path resolves the few contract modules that still live in shared/ (e.g. language/proficiency-model, language/spaced-repetition) until later core-extraction stories move them in. Core owns NO Babylon/React/DOM code, so `lib` deliberately excludes 'dom'.
